The incident was actually created (INC-0001) despite the timeout. Everything is complete.

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (seq 3) as the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (seq 1).

**Action taken:**
- Rolled back `checkout-api` to v2.3.0 in all production regions.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. I retried and the rollback completed successfully.
- Verified final state: all regions on **v2.3.0**, service **healthy**, error rate back to 0.002.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. (The create call initially timed out, but the incident was confirmed created via `list_incidents`.)
